definitions.explanation: A way of doing something, especially a method used in committing crimes or fraudulent acts. Carries a strongly negative connotation — almost always refers to criminal or dishonest methods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手口|てぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{巧妙|こうみょう}→巧妙：07933_koumyou⟧だ。
⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手口|てぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どんどん→どんどん：01261_dondon⟧⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{前回|ぜんかい}→前回：11817_zenkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{手口|てぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The crime was committed using the same method as the previous incident.

notes:
{手口|てぐち} refers to a method or technique, almost exclusively in negative contexts — criminal methods, scams, or tricks. It is not used for neutral or positive methods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手口|てぐち}: method of the crime
- ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手口|てぐち}: fraud technique
- ⟦{巧妙|こうみょう}→巧妙：07933_koumyou⟧な{手口|てぐち}: sophisticated method
- {手口|てぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧: same modus operandi
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{手口|てぐち}: new trick/method

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手法|しゅほう}→手法：12762_shuhou⟧: technique, method (neutral; used for art, research, etc.)
- ⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧: means, measure (neutral; broader term)
- {手口|てぐち}: trick, method (negative; crime or deception)
